title: Clean Eyeshadow II Brush
descriptionHtml:
What it is: An eyeshadow brush with sumptuous fluffy bristles and a soft rounded shape to diffuse and refine color for a seamless finish—making it a blending essential.

What Else You Need to Know: Luxurious and durable, each brush is handmade in Japan by the most prestigious brush maker in the world, using cruelty-free, super-soft nylon fibers and sustainably sourced birch. Thoughtfully designed shorter handles make for easy, effortless application.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Ideal for working in short strokes to diffuse shadow, soften edges, and give rich shades an easy, lived-in look.
-Gently clean brush with mild soap and water.

Gucci Westman's tip:
-"Brushes are my most important tool. For the eyes, I use a flat tapered brush that makes color guide on flawlessly and a rounder fluffier one for the most beautiful blend."—Gucci Westman, Westman Atelier founder
